L005.zh: 每个按键，独立选择模式
L005.en: Choose a mode for each button

L007.zh: 虚拟手柄驱动  ·  检测中

L008.zh: 防重复输入  ·  检测中

L011.zh: 选好按键，调好节奏，然后进入游戏。
L011.en: Choose your buttons and timing, then launch your game.

L014.zh: 连发周期 30–5000 ms · 按下与松开各占一半

L017.zh: 先启动连发助手，再打开游戏。
L017.en: Start rapid fire before launching your game.

L022.zh: 关闭到托盘 · 托盘右键退出
L022.en: Close to tray · Right-click tray to exit

L023.zh: 未检测到 Xbox 手柄，请先连接手柄。
L023.en: No Xbox controller detected. Connect your controller first.

L024.zh: 请只连接一只 Xbox 手柄，并关闭其他虚拟手柄工具后重试。
L024.en: Connect only one Xbox controller and close other virtual controller tools, then try again.

L025.zh: 工具无法读取已隐藏的手柄，已恢复普通输入。
L025.en: The hidden controller could not be read. Normal input has been restored.

L026.zh: 未能区分实体手柄和虚拟手柄，已取消启动。
L026.en: The physical and virtual controllers could not be distinguished. Startup was canceled.

L027.zh: 手柄已断开，连发已停止。重新连接后点击“开始连发”。
L027.en: Controller disconnected. Reconnect it and click Start rapid fire.

L028.zh: 输入线程尚未停止，请稍后重试。
L028.en: The input thread is still stopping. Try again shortly.

L041.en: {0} current mode: {1}. Click to switch to {2}.

L044.zh: 按一下手柄按钮开始持续连发，再按一下停止。点击切换为长按连发。
L044.en: Press the controller button once to start, again to stop. Click here to switch to Hold mode.

L045.zh: 按住手柄按钮时连发，松开停止。点击切换为单击连发。
L045.en: Hold the controller button to repeat; release to stop. Click here to switch to Toggle mode.

L046.zh: 启用长按连发：按住连发，松开停止。
L046.en: Enable Hold mode: hold the controller button to repeat, release to stop.

L047.zh: 启用单击连发：按一次开始，再按一次停止。
L047.en: Enable Toggle mode: press the controller button once to start, again to stop.

L058.zh: 手柄设备已断开，请重新连接后重试。
L058.en: Controller disconnected. Reconnect it and try again.

L059.zh: 手柄接口路径长度异常。

L060.zh: 未找到 Xbox 手柄，请重新连接手柄后重试。
L060.en: No Xbox controller found. Reconnect it and try again.

L061.zh: 检测到多只 Xbox 手柄，请只连接要连发的这一只。
L061.en: Multiple Xbox controllers detected. Connect only the controller you want to use.

L062.zh: 未找到安装包，请完整解压工具文件夹后再运行。
L062.en: Installer not found. Extract the complete tool folder and try again.

L063.zh: 无法启动驱动安装程序。
L063.en: Could not start the driver installer.

L065.en: Could not verify the driver signature.

L066.zh: 驱动签名验证失败，未执行安装。
L066.en: Driver signature verification failed. Installation was not started.

L067.zh: HidHide 正被其他程序占用，请关闭 HidHide 配置窗口后重试。
L067.en: HidHide is in use. Close the HidHide configuration window and try again.

L068.zh: 无法连接 HidHide 驱动，请确认安装完成并按提示重启电脑。
L068.en: Could not connect to HidHide. Complete installation and restart Windows if prompted.

L070.zh: HidHide 返回了无效的 Unicode 数据长度。
L070.en: HidHide returned an invalid Unicode data length.

L071.zh: HidHide 返回的数据长度异常。
L071.en: HidHide returned an invalid data length.

L072.zh: HidHide 返回的状态长度异常。
L072.en: HidHide returned an invalid status length.

L073.zh: HidHide 当前启用了反向名单模式。请先在 HidHide 中关闭反向模式，再使用本工具。
L073.en: HidHide inverse mode is enabled. Disable inverse mode in HidHide before using this tool.

L074.zh: 无法启动异常退出恢复进程。
L074.en: Could not start the crash recovery process.

L075.zh: 未能确认防重复输入设置，已取消启动。
L075.en: Input isolation could not be confirmed. Startup was canceled.

L076.en: Could not read the recovery record.

L077.zh: 手柄恢复尚未完成。请点击“恢复手柄”重试。
L077.en: Controller recovery is incomplete. Click Restore to try again.

L078.zh: 普通手柄输入模式尚未恢复，请点击“恢复手柄”重试。
L078.en: Normal controller input has not been restored. Click Restore to try again.

L079.zh: 临时应用名单尚未恢复，请点击“恢复手柄”重试。
L079.en: The temporary application list has not been restored. Click Restore to try again.

L088.zh: 请先修正卡片中标出的连发周期，范围为 30–5000 ms。
L088.en: Fix the highlighted cycle values first. Valid range: 30–5000 ms.

L089.zh: 请先打开至少一个按键卡片右上角的开关。
L089.en: Enable at least one button using its card switch.

L092.zh: 虚拟手柄驱动未就绪。请安装左侧所需驱动，按提示重启电脑后再试。
L092.en: The virtual controller driver is not ready. Install the drivers on the left and restart Windows if prompted.

L093.zh: 正在恢复普通手柄输入

L101.zh: 未连接 · 请连接手柄

L105.zh: 普通手柄输入 · 连发已暂停

L106.zh: 连发已就绪，按卡片模式操作
L106.en: Rapid fire ready · Use your selected modes

L107.zh: 持续连发已清除。继续后，单击模式需再次按下开始。
L107.en: Toggle firing has been cleared. After resuming, press a button again to start.

L108.zh: 长按模式：松开停止。单击模式：按一次开始，再按一次停止。
L108.en: Hold: release to stop. Toggle: press once to start, again to stop.

L115.zh: 请完成 Windows 驱动安装向导

L116.zh: 驱动安装完成。如果安装向导提示重启，请先重启电脑。
L116.en: Driver installation completed. Restart Windows if the installer requested it.

L118.zh: Xbox 连发助手已经在运行，请从右下角托盘打开。
L118.en: Xbox Rapid Fire is already running. Open it from the system tray.

L119.zh: 连接期间检测到其他手柄，请只连接一只实体手柄后重试。
L119.en: Another controller was detected during connection. Connect only one physical controller and try again.

L120.zh: 虚拟手柄连接超时，请重启电脑后重试。
L120.en: Virtual controller connection timed out. Restart Windows and try again.

L121.zh:
长按：按住连发，松开停止。
单击：按一次开始，再按停止。
L121.en:
Hold: release to stop.
Toggle: press again to stop.
